mapper.select: SELECT id, chart_id, source_account_id, current_result_account_id, retained_earnings_account_id, effective_from, effective_to, create_time FROM t_close_account_rule WHERE chart_id = #{chartId} AND source_account_id = #{sourceAccountId} AND effective_from <= #{at} AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to > #{at}) ORDER BY effective_from DESC LIMIT 1
